mapper.select: SELECT po.id, po.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, po.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, po.total_qty AS totalQty, po.total_amount AS totalAmount, po.status, po.create_user_id AS createUserId, u.real_name AS createUserName, DATE_FORMAT(po.order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderTime, DATE_FORMAT(po.arrival_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS arrivalTime, DATE_FORMAT(po.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, po.remark, po.is_delete AS isDelete FROM erp2.purchase_order po LEFT JOIN erp2.supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN erp2.sys_user u ON po.create_user_id = u.id WHERE po.id = #{id} AND po.is_delete = 0
